$description: The one brand schema. Every brand under tokens/brands/<name>/ is read against it at build. A brand's lock list is written as the paths it may set (`$extensions.com.orrery.unlocked` in its brand.tokens.json); every other path is locked. A brand that declares none inherits `defaultUnlocked`.
$defaultUnlocked: The three slots a client-document brand may set. artifact/head.py enforces the same three for artifact/brands/*.tokens.json and stays the validator of that file format.

optOut.$description: An opt-out is one entry in `$extensions.com.orrery.optOut` in the brand's brand.tokens.json. Every entry needs a non-empty `reason`.
